requires: all required CI successful for current head
no release/deploy or unapproved C-00 decision
reviewer.on_fail: persist actionable rework item keyed by task and reviewed SHA; link PR and evidence
reviewer.on_pass: merge with expected head SHA; verify merged state and record commit
reviewer.post_merge: Verify actual integration push SHA Android and Reboot jobs; deploy must be skipped. Pause further merges on failure or missing required checks; register isolated corrective or revert PR. Never force push.
reviewer.context_evidence: Separate scheduler conversation IDs observed; not sufficient alone to establish input isolation. Require artifact-first review evidence.

schedule: existing hourly worker at :00 and reviewer at :30; consume ready queue regardless of worker progress
dynamic_dispatch: deferred, not mandatory for current architecture

execution.success: Durable verified output and no eligible unblocked work abandoned without evidenced runtime limit
execution.failure: Missing receipt, unsupported stop reason, or eligible work abandoned without evidenced runtime limit
execution.recovery: After two distinct failures register alternative recovery action; do not merely report again
